Their replacement is being prototyped with fractal *rules* that place crisp
boxes (`ifs.rs`): a kaleidoscopic IFS splits a block into a grid, keeps some
cells, twists or lifts them, and repeats; a box goes at every leaf. Hard
edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

boxes (`ifs.rs`): a kaleidoscopic IFS splits a block into a grid, keeps some
cells, twists or lifts them, and repeats; a box goes at every leaf. Hard
edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

cells, twists or lifts them, and repeats; a box goes at every leaf. Hard
edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

cells, twists or lifts them, and repeats; a box goes at every leaf. Hard
edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

cells, twists or lifts them, and repeats; a box goes at every leaf. Hard
edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison

edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

cells, twists or lifts them, and repeats; a box goes at every leaf. Hard
edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

cells, twists or lifts them, and repeats; a box goes at every leaf. Hard
edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

boxes (`ifs.rs`): a kaleidoscopic IFS splits a block into a grid, keeps some

edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

boxes (`ifs.rs`): a kaleidoscopic IFS splits a block into a grid, keeps some
cells, twists or lifts them, and repeats; a box goes at every leaf. Hard
edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

cells, twists or lifts them, and repeats; a box goes at every leaf. Hard
edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

cells, twists or lifts them, and repeats; a box goes at every leaf. Hard
edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison

edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

cells, twists or lifts them, and repeats; a box goes at every leaf. Hard
edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

cells, twists or lifts them, and repeats; a box goes at every leaf. Hard
edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

boxes (`ifs.rs`): a kaleidoscopic IFS splits a block into a grid, keeps some
cells, twists or lifts them, and repeats; a box goes at every leaf. Hard
edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

boxes (`ifs.rs`): a kaleidoscopic IFS splits a block into a grid, keeps some
cells, twists or lifts them, and repeats; a box goes at every leaf. Hard
edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison

cells, twists or lifts them, and repeats; a box goes at every leaf. Hard
edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

boxes (`ifs.rs`): a kaleidoscopic IFS splits a block into a grid, keeps some
cells, twists or lifts them, and repeats; a box goes at every leaf. Hard
edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

cells, twists or lifts them, and repeats; a box goes at every leaf. Hard
edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

cells, twists or lifts them, and repeats; a box goes at every leaf. Hard
edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.

cells, twists or lifts them, and repeats; a box goes at every leaf. Hard
edges by construction, a few triangles per box, and one box collider per
block. Four families stand in an arc about 450 m ahead of the spawn point
(`--opt nofractals` leaves them out). The earlier distance-field version
(`fractal.rs`, soft edges, millions of triangles) is kept for comparison
behind `--opt sdf_fractals`.
